headings.rules: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1-H2. H1 max size text-5xl. Use Manrope for friendly yet functional headers.

body.rules: Loose leading (leading-relaxed) for body text. IBM Plex Sans brings technical clarity to the dashboard.

labels.rules: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and cutoff time indicators.

colors.rules: No pure black or pure white without a tint. Backgrounds have a warm stone/sand tint. Use primary Terracotta (#C65A40) for general actions and Dinner, and Moss Green (#748C69) for Breakfast. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactile mix with Grid Borders. 1px solid border on cards (border-border) with flat background. Add subtle shadow-sm on hover to lift cards slightly.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in this app to keep it warm and grounded. Use solid backgrounds for headers and modals.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating elements like dropdowns. Dashboard cards should remain mostly flat with sharp borders.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing system. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 in grids.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Bento Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Data correlation requires proximity, but generous padding inside cells keeps it breathable.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align forms, tabular data, and key metrics. Optical alignment over geometrical. Subgrids should be used if needed to align card footers.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded (rounded-xl) to feel approachable. Active/hover states must have higher contrast and slight scale effect (active:scale-95).
components.cards: Subtle border (1px), rounded-xl, flat background. No heavy drop shadows by default.
components.tables: Use Shadcn UI tables customized with generous row padding (py-4) and subtle bottom borders. Make sure column headers are distinct.
components.navigation: Visible sidebar or top nav with solid background. Do not hide behind a hamburger menu on desktop.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions for feedback. Hover states on all buttons and cards. Smooth transitions for modal/dialog opening.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NO transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use dark espresso text over warm backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='book-breakfast-button').

icons.usage: Use Duotone or Regular weights. Excellent for warm, friendly internal tools without looking like generic corporate SaaS.

breakfast_banner.description: Close up of food on tray. Use for auth page side panel or breakfast dashboard header.

dinner_banner.description: Warm dinner setting. Use for auth page side panel or dinner dashboard header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font import URLs into the index.html or global css.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, inputs, selects, dialogs, cards, and tables. Do not build these complex components from scratch.
Update the tailwind.config.js with the provided HSL color variables mapping to the 'Organic & Earthy' palette.
Create a login and signup flow (Employee Number + Password).
Create an Employee Dashboard: prominently display cards for booking Today's Dinner and Tomorrow's Breakfast. Clearly mark cutoff times (11:30 PM for breakfast next day, 2:30 PM for dinner same day).
Include a stats section on the Employee Dashboard showing the total number of breakfast and dinner meals consumed in the current month.
Include a simple booking history table or calendar view.
Create an Admin Dashboard displaying total bookings for today, a list of employees, and a date-range filter with an 'Export to Excel' action.
Ensure the application layout feels welcoming, using generous spacing and the defined typography system.
Implement the UI using pure React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Ensure responsive design (mobile-first).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop'. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). This breaks transforms. Use specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Add micro-animations (hover states, transitions) to all interactions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toast notifications. Do not build custom toast.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
